name: Austin Tang
bio: Austin, a Junior at Concordia, has always been passionate about service initiatives. Whether it be volunteering at a local shelter or feeding strays in his residential compound, Austin's commitment to making a difference has now extended to his involvement with Envision Education. Through this work, he hopes to contribute meaningfully to bridging educational gaps while continuing to learn and expand himself through service.

name: Siyeon Kim
bio: Siyeon has joined the Envision team this year and consistently prioritizes serving those who need support. She participates in numerous service activities both in and out of school and actively seeks ways to bridge the digital divide among youth worldwide. She is eager to engage in Envision Education and be a source of assistance for those in need.
